question: Does the raw NatWGS chr22 callset contain a directly observable, genotype-concordant rare-variant bridge to the phased common scaffold?

frozen_contract.identity_marker_floor_source: M27 exact overlap between the frozen baseline and the common scaffold

gates.name: input_and_coordinate_contract
gates.pass_rule: All records are chr22, ordered and hashable; exact biallelic-SNV keys are unique and all three files contain auditable samples or markers.

gates.name: sample_identity_bridge
gates.pass_rule: All 128 canonical raw-WGS sample IDs occur uniquely in the scaffold and every sample has at least 19535 jointly called exact markers with dosage concordance at least 0.99.

gates.name: raw_minor_allele_support
gates.pass_rule: The raw WGS contains at least one biallelic SNV whose minor allele, recomputed from GT, has MAC at least 2 and MAF below 1 percent. This is cohort-level support, not independent-family support.

gates.name: direct_rare_phase_bridge
gates.pass_rule: At least one B2 site has the same CHROM:POS:REF:ALT in the scaffold, concordant carrier genotypes and phased heterozygous carriers where phase is informative.

gates.name: frozen_baseline_marker_coverage_from_raw_wgs
gates.pass_rule: The raw WGS contains at least 80 percent of exact frozen-baseline markers without padding, imputation, liftover or allele substitution. This checks markers only, not parental completeness.

stop_rules: Do not infer phase for a rare site absent from the scaffold.
Do not use INFO/ALT as the rare-allele definition; recompute AC and AN from GT and orient to the minor allele.
Do not treat raw carriers as independent units before PC-Relate.
Do not simulate, run LAI, train, inspect TEST or emit sample identifiers in M27B.
A B4 pass does not establish complete AFR, EUR and NAM parental panels.
